findings.title: Pagination totalPages is off by one for exact multiples
findings.body: In `totalPages`, the formula `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` returns an extra page whenever `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (for example 50 members with a 50-member page). The UI then shows a last page that is empty, and `showingLast`/the next button are wrong on the real last page, so clicking next lands on an empty member list. Use `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)` with the zero case, or equivalent.

findings.title: Public group member page now silently truncates at 50 members
findings.body: The public `members` action now always applies `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` to every group and returns only that page. The public `group/members` template has no pagination controls and the route calls `findMembers()` without any way to advance pages, so any non-automatic group with more than 50 members silently hides the remainder. This is a regression from the previous behavior where non-automatic groups returned all members.

findings.title: Public members endpoint response shape is a breaking change
findings.body: The response body for `GET /groups/:group_id/members.json` changed from a top-level serialized array to an object with `members` and `meta` keys. Any existing API client that still expects the array will break; this public route is not versioned and no compatibility shim is provided.

findings.title: Automatic-group guard is evaluated against the member, not the group
findings.body: Because this template is rendered as the `itemView` for each member, the bare `automatic` lookup resolves against the member object, not the parent group. It is therefore always falsy/undefined, so remove controls are shown even for automatic groups; clicking one sends the DELETE request and the backend returns 422 from `can_not_modify_automatic`. The flag must be passed into the item view or the control guarded in the parent group template.

findings.title: Removal test uses PUT although the new route is DELETE
findings.body: The automatic-group removal spec calls `xhr :put, :remove_member`, but the production route added in this PR is `DELETE /admin/groups/:group_id/members`. Controller specs do not exercise routing, so this test would still pass if the DELETE route or route params were wrong. Add a routing/request spec for the new endpoints.
